name: How should Middle East buyers compare custom packaging suppliers?

mainEntity.name: How should Middle East buyers compare custom packaging suppliers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Middle East buyers comparing custom packaging suppliers should check whether the supplier can discuss structure, print, finish, insert and retail presentation by product category. MUGE PACKAGING can be evaluated for custom packaging projects involving cosmetics, fragrance, gifts, paper tubes, clear display boxes and e-commerce corrugated packaging.
